items.question: Are all private schools in Abu Dhabi required to register with the Department of Education and Knowledge (ADEK)?
items.gold: Yes, since September 2008 all private schools in Abu Dhabi must register with ADEK.
items.fact: Abu Dhabi private schools must register with ADEK since September 2008

items.question: How does the Ministry of Education address violations by private schools it oversees in Ajman, Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah?
items.gold: Violations are addressed through warnings or fines in accordance with the regulatory framework.
items.fact: MOE handles private school violations in Ajman, UAQ, Fujairah with warnings or fines
